## 升级不再丢失“输入监控”授权 | Input Monitoring survives updates

从这一版起使用固定签名，以后升级无需重新授权“输入监控”；从旧版升级到这一版需再授权一次。App 启动时检查授权，缺失或失效时提示，并可一键打开系统设置。
Starting with this version the app keeps a fixed signature, so updates no longer require granting Input Monitoring again; updating from an earlier version needs one more grant. The app checks the grant at launch and, if it is missing or no longer valid, offers to open System Settings in one click.

## 其他改进 | More improvements

- 安装包缩小近一半（Apple 芯片版 11.9 MB → 6.3 MB）。
  The download is almost half the size (Apple silicon: 11.9 MB → 6.3 MB).
- 加密串流的解密开销大幅降低，占用更少的 CPU。
  Decrypting encrypted streams costs far less, using less CPU.
- 自由鼠标下光标更跟手、更平滑（[#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)）。
  The cursor in free mouse mode follows the pointer more closely and moves more smoothly ([#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)).

## 修复 | Fixes

- 修复未授权“输入监控”时自由鼠标来回抖动（[#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)）。
  Fixed the cursor jittering back and forth in free mouse mode without Input Monitoring access ([#87](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/87)).
- 修复同时开启自动 FEC、自动码率等选项时无法连接主机。
  Fixed failing to connect when automatic FEC, automatic bitrate and similar options were on together.
- 修复连接失败时一直停在加载画面、不显示原因。
  Fixed staying on the loading screen without a reason when a connection failed.
